preservedResponsibilities: Task174 independent core-first initialization exposed an eager public-facade cycle after adding derived classes. Original style.hxx enum/borrowed declarations move unchanged into style-values.ts; style.ts reexports the same public values/types/classes. Core,index,iterator and derived implementations import their declaration owner rather than a class facade. This preserves all enum values and method bodies without lazy imports,globals,initialization registries or caller ordering requirements.
